newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHF cuts Deutsche 96 EPS forecast.
newsitem.headline: BHF cuts Deutsche 96 EPS forecast.

text.p: BHF Bank on Thursday lowered its forecast for Deutsche Bank AG 1996 net earnings per share to 4.15 marks from a previous forecast of 4.40 marks.

BHF Bank analyst Dieter Hein said he had lowered his forecast after the release of Deutsche nine-month results earlier on Thursday because of an acceleration in administrative expenditure growth and a sharp rise in taxes.
Deutsche reported an increase in group net profit by 9.1 percent to 1.5 billion marks in the first nine months of 1996, or a rise in earnings per share to 2.95 marks from 2.75 marks.
Its tax payments jumped to 1.5 billion marks from 1.0 billion and administration expenditure was up 9.9 percent at 10.9 billion marks.
In 1995, Deutsche posted earnings per share of 4.15 marks.
Hein said he was maintaining his hold recommendation on the stock and that he was sticking to his forecast of earnings per share of 4.60 marks for 1997.
